title: The closed immersion ideal on a stalk
statement: Let i:Z -> Y be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-closed-immersion], J=i.ker [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], and x a point of Y. Let S_x be the module stalk functor [def-pc-module-stalk-functor]. Fix an O_Y,x-linear isomorphism e:S_x(O_Y) -> O_Y,x carrying each section germ to its ring germ. Put I_x=range(e composed with S_x(J.toModulesι)), as an ideal of O_Y,x. For every z in Z and equality h:x=i(z), I_x is ker(i.stalkMap z), transported along h to an ideal of O_Y,x. If x is not in the image of i, I_x is the whole ring. No coefficient module or tensor multiplication is involved.

source.place: Modules, Lemma 08KS, the ideal-stalk assertions in the final paragraph; affine germ proof of exactness, as in Modules 01AG. Read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08KS; the literature checkout is not present on this machine.

proof.text: On every affine open U, range_toModulesι_app and Scheme.Hom.ker_apply identify the ideal-section range with ker(i.app U). The stalk-map germ formula followed by e carries a lifted ideal-section germ to its ring germ.

At i(z), an ideal germ maps to zero under i.stalkMap by the affine kernel formula and germ_stalkMap_apply. Conversely a ring germ killed by i.stalkMap has a representative whose image section vanishes on a smaller neighbourhood W of z, by Presheaf.germ_eq. IsClosedEmbedding.isInducing.isOpen_iff gives an open V in Y with inverse image W. Choose an affine neighbourhood A of i(z) contained in V intersect U. Naturality of i.app shows the restricted representative has zero image on A and hence lifts to an ideal section.

Off the closed image, choose an affine neighbourhood inside its open complement. Its inverse image is empty; the structure-sheaf sections there form a terminal, hence subsingleton, ring. Every restricted ring section is thus in ker(i.app), and lifts to the ideal. The stalk ideal is top.

from.place: Step 7, essential-surjectivity: the closed-immersion quotient dictionary. This isolates the closed immersion ideal on a stalk.

lean.statement:
theorem closedImmersion_ideal_stalk_range {Y Z : Scheme.{w}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (x : Y)
    (e : (RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace x).obj
      (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf) ≅
        ModuleCat.of (Y.presheaf.stalk x) (Y.presheaf.stalk x))
    (he : ∀ (U : Y.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (r : Γ(Y, U)),
      e.hom (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf).val.presheaf
        U x hx r) = Y.presheaf.germ U x hx r) :
    let S := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor Y.toRingedSpace x
    (∀ (z : Z) (h : x = i.base z),
      LinearMap.range (S.map i.ker.toModulesι ≫ e.hom).hom =
        h.symm ▸ RingHom.ker (i.stalkMap z).hom) ∧
    (x ∉ Set.range i.base →
      LinearMap.range (S.map i.ker.toModulesι ≫ e.hom).hom = ⊤)
